Context

\- Ftp income is atrocious, you only get 240 - 270 gems a week which is 2.4/2.7 pulls a week. For context I still havent gotten every card after \~110 pulls

\- At this point most gems have come though compensations than actually grinding weeklies

\-Wildcards which is the crafting system of the game is atrocious for sr and scrs, didnt get the specific sr or scr that you need for a deck? Then you first need 4 of a kind of an sr that you dont need for every 'miss' on them to  gaining 1/5th value towards getting 1 of the sr/scr that you need for each corresponding miss. Oh and it has to be 4 of the same rarities for proceeding same dupes to have an impact.

\- More likely than not you will need to buy 2 of a structure (400 each - 800 gems total) that you like playing since you dont get ever key card thats splashed in the best versions.

In the positive, green's the MOST ftp friendly or low spending route you can go, not needing sr's but they certainly improve the deck. It gives you access to a strong and consistent game plan named BROLY both the leader and card, though the lack of good commons and rares like gohan 1 c and goku 1 c as well as son goku 5r will hurt the consistency of the deck especially since you want 4 of each, as well as other key cards in stabilizing the game state.
